Rabbiah: The name of an age old song that is sung by Turkish goat herders. The song speaks of nights under the stars, of the hope of green pastures and water over the next hill, and of the reminiscing about old friends.
Rachael:
Nah, she’s not unlucky. Well, maybe once in a while, but after much deliberation the panel here has agreed. Why they changed their mind we’ll never know - smoking too much pot, perhaps. Anyway, forget all that. Rachael is and always was, The Queen of Small Bikinis, and the The Queen of Eroticism. 

The End. (….phew.)
Rachel:
The question is, of course, how can we organise it so Rachel never has to work? Where have we seen her this year? Well, so far she's been on the back of a float at the Berlin Love Parade, dressed in a tiny blue bikini with angel wings and lots of makeup and surrounded by other gorgeous girls who may actually have been transexuals; I saw pictures of her when she was in Rio for Carnavale, except this time she was part of a large dance troupe shaking it down the street, and just last week she was back on a float again, this time at the Gay and Lesbian Mardi Gras in Sydney. 

I'm beginning to see a pattern emerge here. I like it.
Rachelle: Rachelle is continually being offered $$$ and gifts from much older men.
Racquel: Racquel is cute and she's got spunk, but she's not really the camping/outdoors type. It's the creepy-crawlies that freak her out, you see.
Radhika: Like Rosco, she only really comes to life when there's the threat of blood being spilt. But then, HIGH KARUMBA!!!
Radmila: Correct, she's Eastern European, originally, and her sensual magnetism means that she will always need to slash through the men in her life who are unconsiously gravitated towards her, as if she is hacking her way through a dense tropical jungle.
Rae: Boxer. She turned pro three years ago, wins every bout inside two rounds and carries a mean right hook. As a tough man in a recent past life, she’s desperately sad that she can’t urinate without consequence while standing up, in this one.
Raelene: Raelene sticks her head out the back door with a cigarette in one hand, a rum and coke in the other, and screams at her five dishevelled-looking children in the back yard, “GET OFF THE CLOTHES LINE.... AND UNTIE THE BLOODY CAT!”
Raewyn: Raewyn is that lass who, had she entered the dramatic life, would now be a world-famous stand-up comic. Her sense of humour is drier than a decent-sized desert, she divvies out advice and jokes without even knowing she's doing it and she's currently masquerading as a Post Office clerk. In actual fact she's a non-licenced clinical psychiatrist and the post office allows her to meet, befriend and, more importantly, assist thousands of people without them realising it. And all for the price of a stamp. Nice one Raewyn.
Raiha: Maybe she’s Maori maybe she isn’t, but she calls a wanker a wanker, she does anything she pleases and she couldn’t give a flying fuck what the reaction is. It’s women like Raiha who could teach those fundamentalist Muslim fools a thing or two. She has a big laugh, she’s dangerous when she’s drunk and, so, yes, we’re thinking she might be a Maori after all. God bless!
Rajeshni: Ever tried to eat a mango in the nude with your hands, while bouncing on a trampoline? No, we haven't either, but if you did you'd be laughing the whole time, as well as making a glorious, crazy mess. And isn't that why we're here on earth?...to make a big, loud, silly, planet-friendly mess that makes us all laugh with (and at) one another? Rajeshni.
Ramana: Ramana always wanted to act. That's what that tiny scowl in between her eyebrows is - it's all the pent up frustration of imagining what might have been. Ramana, remember though that all those moments passed have got you to here. Apologies for the cliche but tomorrow is a blank cheque and on the grapevine I've heard that the local theatre group needs a strong, female lead for their next play. Want their number?...
Ramona: Dramatic. If she ever cries about anything you can hear her wailing from down the street.
Randa: No fear - she's probably got that tattooed on her arse somewhere, and it encompasses both her physical and moral courage.
Rani: Rani runs her own race. She's a quiet lass who many judge, incorrectly, I might add, as being nearly solemn. She just knows who she is. Do you?
Rania: Like a double-sided mirror that is perfectly clean and with extremely sharp edges, Rania is two-faced and vindictive in her ignorance. So, Rania, forgive me, but some advice……walk up to the nearest mirror. Get up close, so close you can see every pore in your skin, now look into your own eyes....have a deep long look. Do you see that little girl in there? Do you see how much love she's got for the world? And there you have it - go get that little girl!!
Raphael: There ain't nothing slow or low about this lass. Whatever she does she does it better than 96% of the population.
Raquel: There’s no one looking is there? Quick, let's go for a swim!
Rasa: Rasa seems to know these strange little techniques that, while hardly applicable in the western world, could save your life if you were ever caught out in the jungle, alone.
Raylee: Raylee has tons of energy and she needs something to get her teeth into - be it  work, a hobby or some form of artistic expression. She's no politician or philosopher, which is why sitting idle does her head in, as well as those whom she lives with.
Raynee: She's not autistic, although there is a rumour that all of us are, just a little bit, although Raynee's attention is difficult to maintain. It's either because of her mental condition or more likely because she's no fool and she gets bored at the drop of a hat. Keep her occupied, keep her thinking and she'll be great.
Raynor: Utterly capable and calm, Raynor is a shark hunter. Yes, shark hunters are a dying breed and fair enough - god knows the oceans need our help - but she'll slip into the on-land life of the savvy wheeler and dealer, no worries. Needless to say she doesn't tolerate idiots.
Rebecca: Rebecca is a gifted intellectual who should be making the most of her excellent upbringing. Far sexier than anyone might gauge from just looking at her, and like Mary before her, Rebecca can be a wonderful dark horse. However, there is a chance that she is actually a race horse wearing blinkers, in which case she can be incredibly frustrating, if not completely deluded. See how you go...
Rebekah: Big fish in a little pond, she may once have been. But to be honest, Rebekah today is just nice. She's polite, she's precise, she's attentive and she has plenty of friends. Best of all, she's young at heart.
Rebekka: Rebekka’s parents live in Hicksville, and their notion of a wholesome evening meal involves chips, coke, donuts, lollies and icecream.
Rebel: Now here is a fiery competitor, a brilliant strategist and a person who barely wastes a second. As it happens, Rebel's name makes her exactly not what she sounds like, which isn't to say she deliberately goes against the grain (or the system)  - she has no chip on her shoulder and she's comfortable in her skin, so she has nothing to gain from being the centre of attention - but she knows what she wants, and she has the wherewithal and the nous to follow her ambitions. And don't worry, if she needs to rub people up the wrong way in order to get shit done, then so be it.
Rechelle: The world deems Rechelle to be a naturally glittering superstar Goddess of a persona, who simply doesn’t feel like have anything to do with the music industry, and whose smile and nature gravitate people and energy toward her. Rechelle, on the other hand, thinks she’s just Rechelle. (Both parties are correct.)
Reese:
Are we likely to find Reese at a 10-day vipassana mediation retreat?
Maybe not.
Are we liable to stumble upon Reese in the emergency ward at 3am having her stomach pumped?
Thankfully, no.
Do we expect to see Reese hiding from the camera, off to the side, as one of the minister’s best and most trusted advisors at his or her press conference?
Yes, yes you will.
Regan: As a fully-fledged rocker, she's seen Metallica in concert more than anyone.
Regi: Regi is open and loving, and ready to rock n’ roll at a moment’s notice.
Regina: Regina is closely related to Rebecca, except  she has the skill and the determination to spend hours, days and years at her chosen creative task. Success is usually the result. Her moods are greatly affected by the weather.
Rehana: Rehana is the powerful clan leader. It wouldn't matter is she was deaf, blind or mute, she would still fulfil the role perfectly and would be revered and loved by everyone just as she is now. Personal gain and glory don't come into play here.
Remy: Like many Y's, Remy's enourages her to turn around and look inwardly on her search for peace, love and enlightement. Remy is a gem in the making, you just watch...
Rena: Rena is a lovely lady but she's a little intense sometimes. Is it some kind of Hero Curse that she's carrying? No one is sure. Meditation might assist problems to pass through her, rather than getting stuck in her belly, making her feel like she has to do something about them immediately, but she’ll get there. The fact she kicked her last boyfriend out of the house in a very calm and amicable way probably suggests that she’s there already…
Renae: Back down? Renae? Are you fucking serious? Here is a girl who hesitates rarely, who secretly loves the sound of someone shrieking in horror or surprise, and who looks for (and finds) solutions quickly and easily. Yes, occasionally her methods are questionable but she hasn't killed anyone yet who didn't deserve it. And yes, she's quite the party host when she feels like socialising.
Renata: Renata loves new stockings: They can look terribly sexy and dramatic if worn well, and in the case of hunting young men, which, let’s face it, is something of a wonderful pastime of hers, they’re fun and easy to tear off.
Renate: Renate is a full-blown rabble-rouser. So tap her on the shoulder and then stand back!
Rene:
Don’t overrule her if you can help it. Rene gives her all when her heart is in it, so don’t put her off with an early critical call. The trick for her (just as it is for many) is to prudently disregard most of the life-advice society and friends might subliminally give to her, about how to live her life. 
Find your own feet girl, they’re just fine: this is the message from the boys in the commentary box today. 
(And prospective lovers and others: you’ll be hard pressed to find a more devoted partner.)
Renee: The Pakistani bus that’s full of people and careering down a mountain road, having lost the function of its brakes. The 70 people crammed on board are screaming in horror because they know that they’re about to die a bloody and violent death. And they’re right. They do. (What they may not be aware of, however, is that Renee, the bus, loves a bit of comedy intermixed with life's usual offering of tragedy. "Why be boring?" she'll tell you, on her way past you to the valley floor.)
Renelle: Agitated and confused....well....sometimes, but it's not her fault, usually. You see, Renelle seems to attract idiots, which can be unfortunate. She's learned to cope of course, and her radar has improved as she's gotten older, but the side-effect of all these weirdos is that it has filled her life with funny and absurd memories which she wouldn't trade for anything. Likewise, her kids aren't into books and they are loud.
Renie: The graceful artist. You can find her curled over her work in quiet concentration, forgetting the world while she strives, but all of us wait for her to leap up and burst into bloom. What a day that will be.
Rennae:
Okay, so things got slightly out of control last night. That ass hole gate-crashed the party and he wouldn't take no for an answer. We tried to be polite but some people (in this life) reach a moment where all their karma comes back to visit them in one go. And it happened to this joker last night.
Perhaps it was lucky for us he was from interstate? Anyway, after a ridiculous set of unfortunate coincidences, he was accidentally run over by the ute and killed. What do you do? So, yes, I suppose we could have called the cops but what's the point? A fuckwit died in the manner that he lived, and so the universe will take care of him in the next life. At least, this was Rennae's theory and who were we to disagree? She's way smarter than us. Hence, at her suggestion, we dug a hole, took a vow of silence and may he rest in peace.
Renni: Renni is a delight. Yes, she's very similar to her soul sister Rennie, but the missing e gives her that tiny edge in the artistic stakes, the romantic stakes, and the messy bedroom and kitchen stakes. Amen.
Rennie: Rennie doesn't pulverise projects, she sneaks up on the them from the angle no one thought of. Which means she wasn't wasting her time after all…
Reno: Was she conceived in Nevada? Either way, Reno is articulate, punctual and efficient like a sexy little arrow, which has been aimed very well.
Reshma: Like the soothing sounds of a babbling brook, Reshma is the wise and peaceful rock for those that are lucky enough to know her. No, you won’t see her throwing her knickers at a rock star performing on stage in front of her, but you could easily see her receiving a bravery award for saving the life of a drowning man she happened to spot while she was walking her dog along the beach.
Resi: Resi burns incredibly brightly but not forever. She’s a knockout in a scarlet dress.
Rexina: No, not many can do this and that makes sense. It takes a unique blend of calm, impatience and focussed energy to decapitate an unopened champagne bottle with a sword cleanly, god bless her. (Note: Rexina treats all men/lovers, employees/employers the same way.)
Rhani: Rhani is gentle, sensual, agile and noble. She might even be a little bit too gentle.....
Rhelma: Rhelma always starts well and with a definitive sense of direction. Yes, it’s true, she’s often loses momentum or finds herself a little lost, but at least the intent is there at the beginning. I think the only problem, if one exists, is that she believes most of what we humans get up to is a waste of time, so why worry if you get lost later anyway?
Rhianna: Rhianna doesn’t mind a bit of niggle. Yes, society tries to brainwash the female parts of her brain into buying god-knows how many different types of makeup and skin applications, but that crap doesn’t really absorb into her deeper psyche. Rhianna is quite the crusader when she wants to be.
Rhiannon: She’s quiet and she’s not, and her seductive eyelashes hide a more acute acumen than is visible to the eye. Secret schemes are afoot here and she camouflages her controlling nature very well.
Rho: Her parents could have named her Theta, Gamma or Psi, and the result would have been similar. Rho is an unusual, specially educated and eclectic woman who deals with things like publishing houses and production companies, and who enjoys the finer things in life.
Rhominy: Rhominy usually acts without thinking, which is great if you're about to dive into a water from a very high tower (I mean, how many people die from deliberately doing that? Surely none, right?) but not if you've gone to the zoo after snorting a line of cocaine and suddenly feel like hugging the lions.
Rhona: A normal lady who has led an interesting life and raised a proud family. She lives for scrabble.
Rhonda: The hopeless romantic. If you believe in reincarnations, then understand that Rhonda had been around many times before, although she’s still desperately searching. She seems very close to achieving what she’s always wanted but will this life prove to be the one? She does have lots of beautiful thick hair though – that’s nearly always a given.
Rhondda: Boy, doesn't she love it when people try and spell her name with only one 'd'. Anyway, Rhondda is no stooge because she leads from the front. Yes, the one 'd' version might be something of a hopeless romantic, but not this Rhondda. She's more like a bull rider who, despite a twisted ankle and a cracked rib from an fall earlier in the day, is chomping at the bit to get out into the arena again. "Pain is all in the head," she'll tell you. Indeed, there are no prissy little shy girls here, folks.
Rhylee: Normally the crew up here in the box are always very concerned when we meet a player with a silent 'h' in their name. Yes, we know, some of you parents like to do things differently these days and Christ knows there's no accounting for taste, let alone the institution some of these poor people end up spending time in, later in life, but here we see a positive outcome. Phew! Sure, Rhylee is forced to spell her name at least three times each week, but she's okay with it. She knows her parents are abit dippy, and this self-awareness has produced a quirky young woman who is comfortable in her own skin, who speaks her mind, and who is more compassionate than she lets on. Not bad eh?
Rhyll: Another not to be underestimated, Rhyll is rarely impulsive. She expects to attend university and she expects to do well. Many people enter higher education but few wind up being a leader in their chosen field. Rhyll is one of these people.
Ria: Never the fusspot and rarely under duress, Ria slips into gear quickly and without fanfare. She mingles easily with a vast cross-section of humanity and in doing so she is a supreme maitre d' at the best restaurant in town. (Note: Maybe it's a nickname, maybe it's her name - it matters not. Ria is one of those ladies who rule the roost, and she does it via a natural loving of everyone, and a deep sense of fun and enjoyment. Thanks Ria.)
Richelle: The fast-moving manager of the local high-end clothes shop for ladies. Yes, she looks sleek and sensual, and she can turn on the charm, but she also has a finger on the pulse of what's going on around town, how she can do better, and how her strategies and marketing ideas can be improved. Oh yes, and she MUST go on holiday at least once a year, otherwise what's the point?
Ricki: Ricki is up there with Shazza, Liz and Jackie with regards to how she deals with the world. It's rarified air up here, no question, and not many can handle it. Ricki can deal with frost-bite, she can deal with sharks, she can deal with starvation, but what she struggles with is shy or insipid people. Oh yeah, and she just loves meeting up with bullies.
Rie: Rie is one of those rare individuals in the Kingdom who exudes a strange and electric aura that calms, soothes and rejuvenates. That makes her something of a Goddess.
Rihanna: Cabbage soup (Hang on!! I know! Why don’t we all just move to Alabama, go on the doll, eat nothing but quarter pounders and start shootin’ stuff?). Note: If Rihanna was over the age of 25 years old by 2017 then forget all that, for she is absolutely lovely. (It involves Fleetwood Mac, and it’s a long story...)
Riley: If Riley were a migrating goose she'd be somewhere near the front of the 'V', telling the leader where they should be headed as well as what landmarks to keep an eye out for. The whole while telling jokes and keeping everyone sufficiently motivated during the journey. Riley.
Rimini: True, Rimini spends a lot of time off in her own little world, but she's never lost a game of hide and seek in her life. What she should do is ditch all of these STUPID men she keeps meeting, and find herself a REAL man. (i.e: someone who is genuine, and caring, and strong, and funny, of course.)
Rina: With a name similar to a famous Sicilian gangster, Rina is a well-oiled, beautifully maintained, seductively intriguing and absolutely lethal cross-bow.
Rinra: How is it Rinra always accomplishes quite a lot without actually looking like she's doing very much? For example, she pops down the shops for only 20 minutes yet she returns with, not only enough supplies for the house for a week, but with the news that nine people are coming to dinner this Friday night, three people are interested in buying her next product line and she's off to New Zealand Thursday week to meet a supplier/purchaser. Weird eh? The men/lovers in her life can barely keep up with her.
Rita: As an attractive woman with very angular features, Rita lives a streamlined life. She recognizes yet-to-be-friends in an instant and lavishes them with love and attention, while she is polite to those she deems a fool. Rest assured, however, that people in the latter category mysteriously find themselves never encountering her again. It’s one of her great skills.
Riva: A Russian pistol. Sometimes it even works well, but there is no subtlety here at all kids. Riva is sexy and in your face, and just be advised to handle with care.
Rivalee: Man, look at her go! She darts here, she runs over there, she goes out at night and you've no idea where she is. Lucky her street nous is pretty good, eh? Her name bounces at you like a well-struck hockey puck and this is how she arrives into most peoples’ lives. She always therefore leaves a lasting impression!
Ro: Ro doesn’t have time or the inclination to buy things like sexy skirts, expensive perfume or matching underwear because she’s too busy getting-on and dealing with the things that matter – ie. friends, jeans, beer etc.
Roanne: Ignorant? Not a chance. Roanne is no fool, she lines her plans up like she's been organising some of this stuff for years. It actually comes quite naturally. True, she doesn't suffer fools and she's never afraid to tell some fuckwit to just get the fuck out, although that situation rarely happens anyway because her radar for twits is pretty good. Oh yeah, the other thing - if you're a man and you ask her to go camping with you, don't expect her to sit around and be impressed by all your gear. In that scenario she's a hands-on chick and she's here to help make shit work properly. Your car need winching? A fire needs building? You'd be mad not to ask her to help, although you probably won't have to anyway.
Robbie: Robbie gives her all. If she's into fishing then she doesn't catch many although she does love and adore the peace and quiet of the river.
Roberta: Roberta rhymes with Out There. Commercial pilot, cigar smoker, deep-sea diver and tattooist for a while; she’s done it all. But (mothers, fathers, boyfriends and others) don’t expect her to marry.
Robin: Robin lives on a farm in Poland that grows potatoes when the soil isn’t frozen. She has short hair.
Robina: The name of a magic balm that you rub on your belly. The effect is a strange yet pleasant tingling and your knees start to move.
Robyn: Perhaps she's just lucky, but among her many attributes is the fact that Robyn harks from a generation that has never heard of Facebook, or Twitter, or Youtube, sometimes even the internet. What does all this mean? Well, Robyn deals with human, living people and she has a heart. In fact, we've been analysing Robyn's game for some time now, and we've finally understood why she wins the Best Clubman every year: Robyn puts the needs of others before her own. And just imagine what would happen to the world if we all did that?
Rochelle: Oh Rochelle......she’s lovely but what’s all this fussing about??
Rodelle: Rodelle never gets flustered. She can run a business, give a splendid toast, tend a snakebite, deal with a car crash victim and jump out of a plane, and all the while she does the best she can and has as much fun as possible. And if she was named Rodelle because her parents were Rodney and Elaine, then she’s even better than that. She’s always been good with men.
Rohani: Interesting, isn't it, how in a very short space of time a group of people will naturally gravitate to one or two amongst them who seem to have a greater awareness and intelligence than the rest. And she's cute. And on that note, I think the defence rests. Nice work Rohani. (Note: As a lover, she takes her time.)
Rohini: And here we have another one of those girls whom everyone adores. EVERYONE. Friend, lover or stranger, it matters not. Her mind moves quickly and smoothly around the most intractable problems and if she bats her eyelids at any fellow they are basically gone-for, almost immediately.
Roisin: Roisin (Pronounced Row-sheen) is a nice enough girl when you get passed the sheep manure, because though she’d never admit it - I mean, who could?- a part of her expects strangers she meets to bend ever-so-slightly at the knee. We understand that some people call this a curtsey but as I say, once you're passed that crap she's great.
Roma: Well, I suppose it's better than La Paz. (Roma's mum, La Paz is in Bolivia. You can find where that is by looking at a thing called an Atlas.) Be that as it may, Roma is a quite a handful for boyfriends. She can't, and nor should she, be controlled, although a small amount of self-control might do her the world of good.
Romani: So, do you really think Romani walks upstairs to the party? Crap. She tears up the stairs on a 600cc dirtbike and does a wheelie through the house, ending in the kitchen. "Right! Where's the champers kids?"
Romany: Yes, she spells her name at least a dozen times each week and she is no near as free-wheeling as her close cousin, Romani, who at this moment is in court. Anyway, Romany always looks late, which might explain she seems to rush and not idle casually between venues. Clunky in love, although in later years her luck will change.
Romee: Romee spends more time at play than nearly anyone - even in adulthood. If ever trapped in an office she slowly deteriorates until eventually crumbling to dust, like a vampire caught in sunlight.
Romilly: Very bright and extremely dedicated, Romilly loves her job inside the Minister's office but don't even think about getting her on board for that smear campaign you've been talking about. Romilly wants to do good in the world - I'm quite serious - so take that trash idea somewhere else. The End.
Romina: Ever been attacked by a lioness?
Romy: A gifted sculptor who ended up getting a scholarship into Paris's most prestigious art school. Adored by Frenchmen.
Ronalda: Ronalda is a no-nonsense character and the name of the head maid at the mansion. She has about 10 staff who work under her, she knows all about the private lives of the lord and lady who live upstairs, she can handle their children better than they can and she bloody-well just gets on with things. Thank God someone does, eh?
Ronda: The name of a poorly-maintained lawn mower which produces so much noise you need to wear double-insulated ear muffs. The problem is that she revs too high and the throttle doesn't exist. So even if you're just trimming a short growth she howls at full throttle, threatening to tear off down the street. It's a tragic waste of energy really but what can you do? And she's good looking machine as well.
Ronella: Ronella is like Julie Andrews in the 'Sound of Music'. As a well-travelled, wise, affectionate and generally humourous nanny, she cares more about the children than the bloody parents. Teaches them more, too. She attends to the chores around the house like a big rumbling boulder, crashing from room to room. It's actually pretty funny to watch.
Ronelle: Gorgeous and seductive, Ronelle is so cool that she’s got the letter ‘R’ tattooed above her right breast.
Ronelza: Thing is, it's not that she's rude, you understand, but who wants to stand around waiting for stuff? So, if you and her are going for a drink, take my advice - give her the money, stand back then just follow the path she carves through the crowd. She somehow manages to push people out of the way without them even knowing about it.
Ronnie: Tall, slim and slender, Ronnie is as beautiful as she is temperamental. She might even be incredibly temperamental, if not highly prejudicial.
Roo: Roo is a sensual woman who gets shit done, primarily because she operates completely under the radar.
Ros: In the movie, Pulp Fiction, Harvey Keitel plays a character called the Wolf, who comes in to clean up a catastrophic mess with a determined ease, and with style. Had they made the movie in Australia and called the (female) character Ros or Roz, instead, nothing would have changed.
Rosa:
Rosa is short in stature, of Italian descent and she has beautiful eyes. However, DO NOT anger her unless you feel like being on the receiving end of a beating.  
(Hello Rosa, you look wonderful, by the way! xx)
Rosalba: Rosalba has a powerful sex drive, then again she has a powerful drive for everything she does. She doesn’t lose many arguments, the notion of preparing a big luncheon for 30 people only fills her with delight and she continually dares her children (as well as her friends, truth be known) to be unwaveringly BOLD!
Rosaleen: Rosaleen loves a good hot dog stand. (Where's Frankie when you need him?)
Rosalie: Her name starts off okay then it immediately crashes awkwardly – in the same way that you might turn and walk away from a friend that you happened upon while you were down the street, trip over the edge of the curb that you forgot was there, fall onto the road and be hit by a cyclist who is travelling fast enough for them to break your arm. (At least it’s not a car, or something bigger.)
Rosalind: The metaphorical water carrier for the entire tribe. She might not be married to Graeme, but they make excellent cousins.
Rosaline: Yeah, I know, it pisses you off that you get mixed up with Rosalind but so what? You're both great. So, Rosaline, please see Rosalind. (Love, Management.)
Rosamund: Disorderly and lawless, I don't quite think so, although in her younger day she did indeed drive across England one drunken night in hot pursuit of a young man, pissed as the proverbial skunk. I suppose we all get a little bit wise in the end. Thing is though, Rosamund always has this cheeky streak running just beneath the surface. Yes, she tells the kids off when she needs to these days, and she makes sure the family ship is always in order, but give her half a length of playtime and Christ-knows what she'll be up to. Rosamund loves to break the shackles because she fully understands that this thing we call life is a remarkable game, and that you can't take your assets with you when you go.
Rosanna: High maintenance, no limits and great fun to hang out with 69% of the time. You can always sleep later. She's won two MVPs over her career and, man, she’s got the scars to show for it.
Rose: Spiritual, sensual and highly intelligent, Rose has a big personality. She is the kind of girl who rides a very old pushbike, and who has no compunction in kicking men out of her bed as soon as she has finished with them.
Rose-Marie: Always pressed for time, Rose-Marie barely has time to think about things like sex. Why is that, lass? Is there too much on your plate? Do you spread yourself a bit thin? Here, come and sit down and stop talking for a second. Shoosh, just stay here and I'll get a cup of tea. How many sugars? Six? Really? Jesus, no wonder you're exhausted when you get home...
Roseanna: Roseanne hasn't lived some kind of cloistered life. She loves getting her hands dirty and she loves getting her teeth into projects, people and weird situations. Indeed, have you been bitten by her lately? If you have, fear not. She carries no diseases and her teeth are clean.
Roselee: Roselee takes ages at the supermarket these days because she's so choosy. She pines for the old days when bread was bread, milk was milk and the breakfast cereal section had only three varieties, not 30.
Roselyn: "Oh don't be silly Roselyn," she says to herself, when part of her brain suddenly imagines her jumping naked out of a cake at the Christmas party, next week. Accounts is full of such boring people, she thinks. She imagines the scene again and looks over her shoulder to ensure no one is listening before smiling, and turning red with embarrassment. "...can you imagine if I did that?" she whispers.
Rosemaree: If planning for a major event and someone runs inside in a state of panic over some dramatic piece of news that means everyone needs to change their plans, possibly even cancel the event, rather than freak out, Rosemaree will first slap the person in the face to calm them down (she knows very well panic is a destructive contagion) then calmly begin delegating in a methodical manner, and in such a way that those around her think she knew it was going to happen the whole time. And yeah, here’s another lass who loathes mispellings of her name. What can you do?
Rosemary: Whenever Rosemary walks into the room, if you listen closely, you can hear the angels trumpet her arrival from above. In reality, however, and unless you have the hearing of a beagle, you will only be aware of the sound as a subliminal and inner sense of peace, happiness and relief.
Rosetta: Rosetta has a spring in her step and expects plenty from her kids, her friends and her lovers. Life passes too quickly to sit idly by and do nothing - so she says. Strangers love her grin and her energy and even a short trip to do the shopping can take a while. By the way, not just any partner will do for our Rosetta, and he better be able to stand up for himself.
Rosette: An extremely rare and very expensive shotgun.
Rosewitha: Her name sticks in your mouth like a sesame seed caught up the back between molars that you can feel but are unable to get to with your tongue. The result is a woman who struggles on but doesn't seem to laugh and enjoy her life as much as she should.
Rosie: What a chick. Rosie is a modern, extravagant, fun-loving legend who will beat the living shit out of anyone that pisses her off.
Rosilyn: World travel isn't really her thing. Sure, she appreciates the various peoples of the world and she enjoys what they bring to the society in which she lives, but she's a level-headed, pragmatic woman who isn't that impressionable. Her parents taught her well in that regard, perhaps too well, and a simple, honourable life is good enough for her. Theoretically, it should probably be good enough for all of us.
Rosina: A gifted proof-reader, editor and final-person to have a look at the contract that's been drawn up. She therefore knows the rules, knows how to break them, and moves quickly and rather efficiently through life. Plus, she's happy and emotionally fit, she's got a great smile when she pulls it out and she helps awkward people relax.
Rosita: “Rozzzzzzitaaaaaa.....!!!!!!!” her friends will squeal as she walks into the room because, finally, the glorious whirly-bird has arrived!
Rosma: The name given to any local aneasthetic. At first it stings then soon…….peace.
Rosslie: The personal trainer who is impressed at her 'guns' and her six pack. She's a hard task master.
Rosslyn:
Proud Christmas wrapping paper. She MUST be taped up correctly and neatly, and the gift itself should be presented front and square beneath the tree, if you're into that kind of thing.
Question: Are there any Buddhist/Hindu/Muslim Rosslyns out there?...
Rowdy:
Stubborn? 
You bet. 
Funny? 
100%.  
Sexy? 
Yep.
Tomboy? 
Usually. 
Smart as a fox? 
Tru dat.
Is she ever early?
……is that a serious question??
Rowena: Rowena is just as happy in a bar of bush blokes as she is in front of the camera signing billion dollar deals with offshore mining companies. If you are genuine then she will give you your due and if you’re not, she will either ignore you or tell you to fuck off. Rowena.
Roxanne: If Roxanne is a city-dweller then she is surprisingly unadventurous and a tad prejudicial, as well as being totally institutionalised by the contraints of a life led mostly indoors. If she's a country girl, however, Roxanne is funny, and loud, and she tries different things and she'll listen attentively to unusual people. Rarely does the environment have such contradictory outcomes on a person.
Roxy: A type of Impulse spray for girls. It’s a favourite with some sixteen year olds who cover themselves in it before heading out to nightclubs, underage, although it only really works when the accompanying mini-skirts are so short that any attempt to sit down results in a genuine knicker-flash.
Rozina: A huge offshore racing boat. She's powered by two giant outboard engines with glistening stainless steel counter-rotating props and you can hear her tear up the opposition from miles away, and whoa-betide any beggars she meets while walking down the street, for they’ll be told to better themselves in no uncertain terms.
Rozzie:
Jesus H Christ on a popsicle stick! Pierced fingernails, nipples, lips, belly buttons, and probably even a pierced you-know-what, Rozzie is about as quiet and as subtle as the opening few seconds of a Formula 1 Grand Prix. She doesn't just walk into a room, she crashes the stolen bulldozer straight through the wall, her raised fist waving outside the cabin, yelling, "FUCK YEEEAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHH!!!!!!!"
Need we say any more?
Ruba: Ruba is one of those artists whose studio is massive, and yet filled to the brim with the spoils of her labour. It's a miracle she knows where everything is. Totally obsessive once she gets rolling, Ruba cannot and will not be distracted and, my god, you should hear her in bed…
Rubi: Ever seen the movie "Bruce Almighty" with Jim Carey? Well, just after Morgan Freeman confers 'Godness' onto him, Bruce struts off down the street wielding his new powers. At one stage he turns, fires his Godness at a fire hydrant that explodes water into the air right on cue. The fire hydrants name was Rubi. She's red and she's in your face right when you need her most. Amen.
Ruby:
Option A:  Ruby lives alone with her 45 cats in a house filled with ornaments and trinkets from her two trips to India. She hopes to achieve enlightenment soon but little does she know that she’s on life number one. 

Option B:  If she isn’t a street fighter, Ruby is more like a Zen Buddhist monk and far and away the most (quietly) skilful and compassionate human being in the building.
Ruth: The champion shearer and realist. She beats all the men all the time, and she wouldn't trade her love of ciggies, Wild Turkey or her blue cotton singlets to save her life.
Ruwani: The lazy and beautiful Sri Lankan Goddess of Safe Animals.
Ry: There are some creatures out there in the Kingdom who are difficult to describe, because to do so would mean trying to pigeon-hole one of the most pure, replete and centred individuals any of us will ever meet. Yes, we are all different, and we hate to say this, but some of us are just quieter, more introspective and more brilliant than the rest. Ry.
Ryanna:
Ryanna is about as shy as a breaching mother humpback who has taken a dislike to your sea kayak an its proximity to her calf, and who is now totally airborne and 2 metres directly over your head.
So, Ryanna, yes, she’s lovely, she’s powerful, she’s sexual, she has a big smile, she loves a busy social life and she has a sense of humour. And in the next life we suggest you steer well clear of her calf.
The End.
Ryland-Jane: A private school girl who trails her minions like the tail of a $300,000 Versace wedding dress. Ironically, if her dad doesn't spend at least this much on her wedding he'll be in the bad-books for the rest of his days.
Ryley: Ryley is proactive and a natural leader. Boys have to chase her hard to catch her, and only the best will do.
Róise: Róise behaves like a queen who has been accidentally dropped into a tiny out-of-the-way town with no money and no assistants, and where no one knows her.
